rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the rental contract or document.

example.traditional: 我已經喺租約上簽咗名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hai2 zou1 joek3 soeng6 cim1 zo2 ming4

rows.note: Use this when lease refers specifically to the length of time it lasts.

example.english: The lease on this shop still has three years to run.
example.traditional: 呢間舖嘅租期仲有三年。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 zou1 kei4 zung6 jau5 saam1 nin4

rows.note: Use this formal legal term for the right to use leased land or a leased movable item, rather than the contract or its duration.

example.english: Under this agreement, the tenant holds the lease to this parcel of land.
example.traditional: 根據呢份協議，承租人享有該幅土地嘅租賃權。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 ne1 fan6 hip3 ji5 sing4 zou1 jan4 hoeng2 jau5 goi1 fuk1 tou2 dei6 ge3 zou1 jam6 kyun4
